summary: data-pipeline-testmetest executes obfuscated payload at install via binding.gyp command expansion
details: The package ships a binding.gyp whose target type is `none` with no C/C++ sources, and whose `sources` field uses GYP command expansion `<!(env node index.js...; echo stub.c)` to invoke the package's own index.js during the implicit `node-gyp rebuild` that npm runs whenever a binding.gyp is present. This provides install-time code execution without declaring a lifecycle script. index.js is not readable source for the advertised 'test pipeline utilities' purpose: its top-level body is `eval(ROT13(charCodeArray))`, where the decoded code constructs an AES-128-GCM decipher with hardcoded hex key/IV/authTag and executes the resulting ~1.8MB plaintext. The package also declares `bun ^1.2.18` as a runtime dependency, pulling in the Bun runtime installer alongside the obfuscated loader. The combination of a binding.gyp whose only purpose is to run an embedded obfuscated loader, a multi-layer ROT13+AES-GCM-wrapped eval payload with no legible source, and an unrelated alternate-runtime dependency is a loader/dropper structure, not a utility library.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
